notes.title: Demo version this Fall
notes.notes:
Dear players!
Soon we will share with you the demo version of Tales of Meadows. Players will have the opportunity to take on the role of Philip for the first time, participate in a real historical battle, and immerse themselves in an epic journey full of challenges across the meadows and settlements of the ancient Principality of Turov.

In the demo version, players will have access to two storyline locations that will kick off the story of Tales of Meadows in the full version of the game.Currently, a closed beta test is underway among our Boosty subscribers; however, this fall we will share the game with all of you!

Thank you for continuing to follow our project, for your support, and for adding us to your wishlist! It's truly incredibly important for us.
